<subject>Succession Announcement</subject>
<body>
Dear Team,

I am pleased to announce that the Board has approved my recommendation to appoint Michael Lawson as Chief Executive Officer, effective following our next board meeting on March 15, 2024. Michael will continue to serve as Managing Director and Chief Operating Officer. I will remain as Chairman of the Board and will continue to work closely with Michael on the strategic direction and daily operations of Tasman Ridge Resources Ltd.

Michael will step into this role at a time when the company is performing exceptionally well and positioned for significant growth. He is more than ready to lead, and after 18 years as CEO, I am ready to focus on a new role within the company.

Our succession plan has been thoughtfully developed over time, allowing Michael and me to combine our strengths to build a company that consistently exceeds expectations, including our own. We look forward to deepening our partnership as Michael takes on his expanded responsibilities.

There are no plans for further changes to our leadership team or shifts in our strategic direction at this time.

Please join me in congratulating Michael on his new role. I am confident 2024 will be a successful year for Tasman Ridge Resources Ltd.

Warm regards,  
David Harper  
Chairman, Tasman Ridge Resources Ltd  
</body>
